title: Recall: Select values with exhaustive branches
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

range.clue: In a match on code: u32, write the complete arm mapping the inclusive range from 3 through 5 to the string literal "middle". Omit the comma.

either.clue: In a match on code: u32, write the complete arm mapping either literal 1 or literal 2 to "small", using an or-pattern in ascending order. Omit the comma.
